title: Les désirs sont déjà des souvenirs
format: Hardcover, cloth boards with tipped-in photograph

description.main: Les désirs sont déjà des souvenirs gathers four decades of Claude Nori's photographs of Italian summers, adolescence and the seaside, published to accompany his 2012 retrospective at the Maison Européenne de la Photographie in Paris.
description.extended:
Les désirs sont déjà des souvenirs gathers four decades of Claude Nori's photographs of Italian summers, adolescence and the seaside, published to accompany his 2012 retrospective at the Maison Européenne de la Photographie in Paris.

Contrasto issued the book in Rome in September 2012 for the exhibition Claude Nori, éditeur et photographe, which the MEP co-produced with the Rencontres d'Arles. It is a clothbound hardcover of 176 pages. A snapshot is tipped into the front board and Nori's name is hand-lettered in red. The pictures run from 1968 onward, in black and white and colour: beaches, bathers, flirtations, cafés and small towns on the Italian coast. The texts are in French. The title translates as Desires Are Already Memories.

Nori was born in Toulouse in 1949 to Italian immigrant parents. In 1975 he founded Contrejour in Paris, the press, magazine and gallery that gave a generation of French photographers their first books. His own books, among them Lunettes (1976), Stromboli (1991) and Un été italien (2001), set out the autobiographical mode he calls photobiographie. The MEP show was the first to put that work beside the history of Contrejour.
description.artist_bio: Claude Nori (born Toulouse, 1949) is a French photographer and publisher. He founded Éditions Contrejour in Paris in 1975, publishing more than 150 books and the magazines Les Cahiers de la Photographie and Caméra International, and his own photographic work, centred on Italy, adolescence and the seaside, is associated with the mode he calls photobiographie. He lives in Biarritz, where he co-founded the Terre d'Images festival in 1999.
description.exhibition_context: The book accompanied Claude Nori, éditeur et photographe at the Maison Européenne de la Photographie, Paris, 5 September to 4 November 2012, co-produced with the Rencontres Internationales de la Photographie d'Arles. The exhibition paired Nori's own photographs with the publishing history of Contrejour for the first time.
